about: Golden vectors for the Memories & notes search core (com.gpo.yoin.shared.search: fold, match, fragment, the ledger search across accounts, attachments, the All page and its packing, the type chips, play from a note's second), generated from :shared Kotlin through YoinMemorySearch by MemorySearchGoldenTest (androidHostTest). Do not edit by hand. Each "search" runs over "ledger" + "aiTitles"; each "pages" vector lays out "songs"/"albums"/"artists"/"playlists" (or none, withService false) with the "search" result for its query and account and the attachments of "albums".
offsets: UTF-16 code units; ranges are [start, end), -1/-1 for none; scores are 32-bit floats
